def main():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    s = data[1]
    ans1 = 0
    ans2 = 0
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        ch = s[i]
        if ch == '(':
            len_val = 0
            while i + 1 < n:
                next_ch = s[i + 1]
                if next_ch == ')':
                    if len_val > 0:
                        ans2 += 1
                    break
                if next_ch == '_':
                    if len_val > 0:
                        ans2 += 1
                        len_val = 0
                else:
                    len_val += 1
                i += 1
        elif ch == ')' or ch == '_':
            len_val = 0
            while i + 1 < n and s[i + 1] not in (')', '_', '('):
                len_val += 1
                i += 1
            ans1 = max(ans1, len_val)
        else:
            len_val = 0
            while i < n and s[i] not in (')', '_', '('):
                len_val += 1
                i += 1
            ans1 = max(ans1, len_val)
            i -= 1
        i += 1
    print(f"{ans1} {ans2}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
